meta.name: geomaster
meta.description: Comprehensive geospatial science skill covering remote sensing, GIS, spatial analysis, machine learning for earth observation, and 30+ scientific domains. Supports satellite imagery processing (Sentinel, Landsat, MODIS, SAR, hyperspectral), vector and raster data operations, spatial statistics, point cloud processing, network analysis, cloud-native workflows (STAC, COG, Planetary Computer), and 8 programming languages (Python, R, Julia, JavaScript, C++, Java, Go, Rust) with 500+ code examples. Use for remote sensing workflows, GIS analysis, spatial ML, Earth observation data processing, terrain analysis, hydrological modeling, marine spatial analysis, atmospheric science, and any geospatial computation task.

copy.tagline: 分析卫星影像与地理空间数据,构建空间机器学习模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常处理卫星影像和地理空间数据,需要多语言示例
copy.tagline_en: Process satellite imagery and geospatial data, and build spatial machine learning models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with remote sensing and GIS data and need code examples in multiple languages

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能处理地理空间数据：读取和处理卫星影像、矢量地图数据，计算 NDVI 等光谱指数，做地形分析、网络分析，还能用 Python、R 等 8 种语言写代码完成任务。
howto.when: 当你提出遥感影像处理、GIS 空间分析、地形或水文建模等地理空间计算任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Sentinel-2 影像算 NDVI，并输出 GeoTIFF。
say.note: Claude 会生成相应 Python 代码并解释步骤。

say.text: 用 GeoPandas 做两个图层的空间连接，统计每个区域的平均值。
say.note: Claude 会给出空间连接和聚合的代码。

say.text: 用 STAC 搜索旧金山 2023 年云量低于 20% 的卫星影像。
say.note: Claude 会演示 STAC 查询和加载影像的流程。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude handle geospatial data: read and process satellite imagery, vector map data, compute spectral indices like NDVI, perform terrain and network analysis, and write code in 8 languages including Python and R.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for tasks like remote sensing image processing, GIS spatial analysis, terrain or hydrological modeling, or any geospatial computation.

say_en.text: Help me compute NDVI from Sentinel-2 imagery and output a GeoTIFF.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Python code and explain steps.

say_en.text: Use GeoPandas to spatial-join two layers and average values per zone.
say_en.note: Claude will provide code for join and aggregation.

say_en.text: Use STAC to search satellite images of San Francisco in 2023 with cloud cover under 20%.
say_en.note: Claude will demonstrate STAC query and loading.
